referenceFunction.generalComment: The data set is based on the operation of storage hydropower stations in the alpine regions of Europe and other specific data. Data are the same for reservoir and pumped storage power plants, the impacts of the area used, the amount of turbined water and the greenhouse gas emissions are shared. The lifetime is assumed to be 150 years for the dams and 80 years for the other material. The data describe a mix and can therefore not be used for an individual storage hydropower station. This dataset is recalculated based on Frischknecht et al. (1996) and Bauer (2007), complemented with data from Vattenfall (2008) and Diem et al. (2008).; UUID: fbd1f9e7-9b53-32ce-b7b5-29dd0a7a66bf
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Operation of an average storage hydropower station in the non alpine regions of Europe. It includes the area transformed and occupied, the volume of the reservoir, greenhouse gas emissions, the consumption of lubricant oil and the amount of turbined water.
